title: Collider constraints on electroweak-multiplet inelastic dark matter after the LZ event
question: Do LEP and LHC searches allow the Higgsino-like (doublet) and wino-like (triplet) masses and splittings that fit the LZ event, and what would HL-LHC and future colliders add?
headline_result: The LZ-fitting Higgsino (mu >= 259 GeV, delta 310-376 keV) has Delta m+- = 342 +- 10 MeV at 1 TeV (c tau 0.71 cm, tau 0.024 ns), independent of delta to 0.19%; this lifetime is 1e7 times too short for pixel-tracklet searches (P(r>12 cm) = 5e-8 at beta gamma = 1), soft-lepton searches need Delta m >~ 5 GeV, and LEP/monojet reach lies below the 259 GeV floor, so every P007 fit point including the thermal 1.1 TeV Higgsino is allowed and unprobed by LEP, LHC and HL-LHC; only FCC-hh or a 10 TeV muon collider would reach it.
key_numbers: Delta m_rad Higgsino 258/314/329/342/349/353 MeV at 100/300/500/1000/2000/4000 GeV, asymptote alpha m_Z/2 = 356 MeV; wino 161 (on-shell)/173 (MSbar) MeV; tree piece (0.1-2.1)e-3 delta <= 0.8 MeV, 0.19% change for delta 100-400 keV; Higgsino 1 TeV BR(pi/e/mu) 0.919/0.050/0.031, c tau 0.712 cm (0.65-0.79); wino 165 MeV: 0.193 ns, 5.77 cm; P(r>12 cm) 5e-8 (bg=1), 2e-4 (bg=2) vs wino 0.17/0.42; sigma_H 201/23/0.67 fb -> pairs 93/200/2000 at 1 TeV for 140/300/3000 fb^-1; toy HL-LHC tracklets 5.0 (300 GeV), 0.016 (1 TeV) at bg=2; LZ floors 259/453/596/821 GeV at delta 300/350/366/380 keV; chi2: e+e- closed, tau(nunu) 4.6e5 s, tau(gamma) ~0.06 s
model_or_mechanism: pure Higgsino doublet and wino triplet; one-loop EW splitting (Feynman-parameter form), tree-level O(delta) piece from P007 gaugino table, W-exchange chargino widths, recalled 13 TeV Drell-Yan cross-sections, exponential tracklet survival
